aliases: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries BACnet points list
equipment_type: Air conditioner BACnet gateway (1 indoor unit)
applies_to: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries RAC, FD, KX6 and KXR6 (VRF) series indoor units, via the X-Y remote-controller bus.
summary: A one-unit Intesis interface connected to the X-Y bus between an MHI indoor unit and its wired remote controller, serving the unit as a BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP device with 30 fixed objects. Some objects (room temperature from BACnet, outdoor temperature) only work when the gateway is set as master of the X-Y bus.
notes: OutdoorTemp_status (AI 8) and RoomTemperature_command (AO 1) only work with the gateway set as X-Y bus master (DIP switch).
CenterRemote (MI 9) reports which controller has priority.
Units shown as °C follow the °C/°F DIP switch.
ErrorCodeM state texts are the MHI error codes listed in the manual.

source.title: Intesis BACnet - RAC, FD, KX6 and KXR6 (VRF) series User Manual (INBACMHI001R000)

integration.summary: Connect the gateway to the indoor unit (X-Y remote-controller bus, no polarity), set the BACnet network on its DIP switches, then write the _command objects (on/off, mode, setpoint, fan) and read back the matching _status objects. One gateway serves one indoor unit (or one remote-controller group), so give each gateway its own MAC address and device instance.

minimum_points.name: SetPoint_status
minimum_points.why: Setpoint the unit is really using

integration.enable: No enable point or BMS/local switch is documented; the gateway accepts BACnet commands as soon as it is communicating with the unit. A wired remote controller can still be used in parallel; BV 2 LockRemoteControl locks it.
integration.remote_sensors: AO 1 RoomTemperature_command sets the room temperature the MHI unit uses, but only when the gateway is configured as master of the X-Y bus; as slave the write has no effect.
setup: BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP is chosen with a DIP switch (MS/TP is the default); switch changes need a power cycle.
BACnet IP: factory static IP 192.168.100.246; change it (or select DHCP) with the Intesis configuration tool.
MS/TP MAC address 0-127 is set on DIP switches; baud rate is DIP-selectable (9600-115200) with autobaud as the default, which matches the baud rate of another MS/TP device running a fixed rate.

Default device instance 246000. In automatic mode the instance is a base (246000, changeable in the configuration tool) + the SW2 MAC address; it can also be set manually or by writing Object_Identifier.
A DIP switch selects slave (default) or master on the X-Y bus; master is needed for AO 1 and AI 8.
gotchas: Every function has a separate _command (AO/BO/MO, commandable) and _status (AI/BI/MI) object; write the command, read the status.
Temperatures follow the Celsius/Fahrenheit DIP switch; the BACnet Units property changes with it.

The Occupancy MV and its four AVs drive built-in logic that sets mode, setpoint and on/off; leave Occupancy at 3 (Disabled) unless you use it, and any manual on/off, mode or setpoint change cancels it.
If an MHI wired remote is on the same bus, set master/slave roles so the two do not conflict.
